raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 345 raw_transactions rows tagged amount_unit='USD_CENTS' (all in batch 12, dated 2026-01-16) store amounts in cents, but silver_transactions treats every amount as dollars. Converting cents to dollars in silver_transactions corrects the data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN amount / 100.0 ELSE amount END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
